title: Release Evidence Gate Manifest
description: Immutable release-gate evidence manifest (BUG-407-005). Generated by script/release-evidence.ts; never overwrite an existing manifest — create a new gate attempt instead.

gate_id.description: Gate identifier, e.g. release-gate-20260819, R1-C, R2-S3

commit.description: Full 40-char git SHA the evidence is bound to

evidence.description: Evidence entries; order is part of the immutable record

kind.description: Evidence category aligned with BUG-407-005 R1/R2/R3/M1-M4 classification

label.description: Unique identifier of this entry within the gate

path.description: Repo-relative path of the evidence file; null when the original artifact is not kept in the repo

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the file at path; null together with path

conclusion.description: Recorded conclusion, facts and source for this entry

signatures.description: Sign-off chain placeholders: each domain owner plus the release owner must sign before the gate closes

actor.description: Signer identity; empty string until signed

at.description: Signing timestamp, ISO-8601 UTC; empty string until signed
